comment.body:
Foster, you're completely missing the real problem.

Morality is a symptom of the problem, not its cure.

Codependence is the problem. Only codependents need morality, because they need someone else to tell them when they're "good" or "bad".

In other words, aside from authorities and external systems, structures, and institutions, they literally don't know who the fuck they are.

In the metaphor of Jesus, codependence is the "broad way" and full humanness is the "narrow way". You can preserve ego on the broad way. You substitute the judgment of others for your own on the broad way.

The "strait gate" is your decision to love and cling to the truth, to honesty, to the best for BOTH others and yourself, and stop betraying yourself for the sake of the delusory "benefits" promised on the broad way -- where you pretend to move forward "together".

The strait gate allow only 1 to pass at a time, and only one -- you -- to begin on the way that is yours and yours alone.

Morality not only can't accomplish that, it doesn't even try, and it was never intended to.

https://www.freetothrive.com/blog/a-universal-morality/

comment.body:
Sorry, Terrance: wrong.

We do not have to create our own culture.

In fact, we'd better fucking STOP creating "cultures".

Culture is the cultification of creativity: the freeze-framing, dehydrate-and-mount it, skin-and-stuff-it result of KILLING creativity and iconizing it as a testament to ego.

Which is why the "greatest artists" tend to be some of the worst, most egotistical mutherfuckers.

Because every single culture, everywhere and at every time, served as an inhibitor and opposer to real creativity -- which every single one of them saw as a threat, as "the enemy".

Of course they did. Because creativity -- real creativity -- ALWAYS INTERFERES, DISRUPTS, AND SPELLS THE DISSOLUTION OF THE KILL-AND-FREEZE DEATH MARCH THAT CULTURE IMPOSES.

Read some fucking history about what cultures ALWAYS do to their own up-and-coming, genuine and genius creators.

Always.

And read what the codependent mentality of cultism that insists on enculturation ALWAYS does to them after they've obliterated the culture they were locked in until they blew it open. 

It subsumes their breakout and petrifies it into the next culture.

If your creativity does not threaten the end of the cult of culture, you're a replicator, not a creator. And if you smash the current culture only to make a new one out of your creation, you just become the new cult-maker, same as the old cult-maker.

It's significant that so many artists who detest cult-making and cult-leading end up committing suicide rather than get sucked back into the cesspool.

Yes, all creators begin as replicators -- that's how you master the method.

Method mastery doesn't make you a creator. Morphing the method into a new variant doesn't make you a creator. 

Using your mastery to destroy the gaslit illusion that the current culture is the definition, superior, the "best ever" and likely the end-all, be-all... 

THAT is creativity. 

All the rest is circle-jerking.

comment.body:
“We have to create culture. Don’t watch TV, don’t read magazines, don’t even listen to NPR. Create your own roadshow.”

In 1999, Terence McKenna delivered a lecture called Shamans Among the Machines, offering a sharp critique of modern, mass-consumer culture.

It’s here that he drops one of his most famous lines: “Culture is not your friend.”

McKenna argued that mass culture isn’t designed to make us free, creative, or fully conscious, but to condition, distract, and domesticate us.

It trains people to consume, conform, and identify with manufactured values — status, trends, celebrity, fear — keeping attention fixed outward rather than inward. This erodes imagination and personal autonomy.

His antidote was simple: withdraw psychic energy from cultural noise and create something yourself — art, ideas, lived experience. 

Creation restores agency. Passive consumption gives it away.

As he put it:

“By putting the art pedal to the metal, we maximise our humanness and become much more necessary and incomprehensible to the machines.”

In another lecture, McKenna sharpened the point:

“If you’re worrying about Michael Jackson or Bill Clinton or somebody else, then you are disempowered… This is shit-brained thinking. That is all cultural diversion.”

His message endures because our predicament remains the same. Culture will happily think for you, unless you decide to think, and create, for yourself.

Source: Shamans Among the Machines (1999), Terence McKenna.

comment.body:
What the fuck is wrong with everybody? 

The reason you see this as a fight is because of the mindfuck done to you by the very same psychotic "powers" you pretend you're going to fight. 

You're fighting for control of a slave-powered train designed and created and controlled by people you fully believe are powerful and, increasingly, realize are evil. 

It's a joke. 

The whole system runs on slavery and extortion, so the whole system is an accurate expression of the psychosis we've long called "power", and you want to fight over it because, in your mind, you're existentially dependent on it. 

First, how could you ever hope to win a fight when you're so mindfucked as to be oblivious that the fight itself is part of the psychosis? 

And even if you win this "fight", what are you going to do with the slave-run extortion train? Keep it going with you at the controls? 

This is why Paul the apostle wrote that our fight is not against flesh and blood. It doesn't matter if you win a fight against flesh and blood when both you and those you conquered  continue psycho-spiritually locked under exactly the same psychosis. 

It doesn't matter who controls the slave extortion train. What matters is that you refuse to get off it. 

And you have no fucking clue in hell how to get off it, what to do and where to go if you got off it, and no concept or confidence that you could survive if you did get off it. 

So, you have absolutely no intention of getting off it. 

And that's why you fight over it. And that's why the fight is phony, ridiculous, and insane. 

But it's all you know. And you use that as your excuse, too. Even though you know for a fucking fact the corrective for your ignorance, you refuse it. You absolutely refuse it. 

You'd rather cling to the dubious innocence of ignorance and die than rectify your stupidity and live.

I guess you'll have to mount this fight, win this fight, and realize that you accomplished absolutely nothing positive before, maybe, you'll stop clinging to your psychosis.

Sharyl Attkisson, in a 2006 report for CBS:  



Over 20 years, the percentage of seniors receiving flu shots increased sharply from 15% to 65%.  Flu deaths among the elderly should have taken a dramatic dip.

Instead, flu deaths among the elderly continue to climb.

It was hard to believe, so researchers at the National Institutes of Health set out to do a study adjusting for all kinds of factors that could be masking the true benefits of the shots, but no matter how they crunched the numbers, they got the same disappointing result.

Flu shots have not reduced deaths among the elderly.

Think about that.

Where did their BELIEF in the "true benefits of the shots" originate?

Absolutely not from scientific research and objective data.

No, they believed BEFORE they had any such thing.

And then, when they DID get actual data, it violated their belief.

So, what is any mindfucked, codependent "scientist" supposed to do when science itself tells them they're bass-akwards wrong?

Well, OF COURSE! 

MAKE THE FUCKING SCIENCE TELL THEM WHAT THEY FUCKING WANT TO HEAR.

And so they did. You can bet they did their best.

And science prevailed.

You know what it means when a scientist gets a "disappoint result"?

It means they were ANTI-SCIENTIFICALLY BIASED FROM THE GET-GO.

A real scientist will tell you: there is no such thing as a "bad" scientific finding. There is no such thing as a failed experiment, only an unexpected result. 

IF YOU ARE DISAPPOINTED BY WHAT SCIENTIFIC RESULTS TELL YOU, YOU WENT INTO YOUR PSEUDO-SCIENTIFIC EXERCISE BIASED.

Patent psychosis.

1. Governments articulated and declared the rights. Without that articulation publicly and officially declared, where exactly do these rights exist?

In other words: WHAT THE FUCK ARE YOU BLATHERING ABOUT?

I wish more people weren't fucking deranged, idiot cultists who internalize every bit of PSYOP bullshit their governments foist on them.

comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
What should you do? 

What are your obligations as the citizen of an evil empire? 

You mean: given that there's no fucking way in hell that you'll even casually entertain the question of whether there should be nations at all, run by psychopaths who not only don't give a fuck about shredding little girls into tiny bits, but actually enjoy doing it because it proves they can; and you have no fucking intention of abandoning your infantile death-clinging to the very systems that not only enable the psychotically murderous to do their evil, but rather spawn, incubate, nurture, and encourage their psychoses, creating "the rich and powerful" from which to select the most deranged and evil of them for the insanity known as "power" -- what are your obligations, then? 

What obligations do you have as a responsible citizen and a good person in an evil nation?

What should you do in an evil society permeated by an evil culture, operating as an evil system -- one that you've no fucking intention of disowning or leaving, let alone terminating, let alone obliterating? 

Yes -- what should you do?

Well, what can you do when one side of your brain critically depends on evil for your survival and fanatically clings to your identity as a member of a heinous, evil entity and the other side desperately scratches and grasps for a way to make words and spin yarns that present you as the golden ring in the swine's snout?

What then? 

Well, honestly, really...

What the fuck does it matter?

What the fuck difference will it make for a person like you to do one thing instead of another, except as it valorizes your and signals your copious bullshit virtues? 

Honestly, really... 

What the fuck are your "obligations"? 

Obligations? 

In other words, you don't give an actual fuck. 

The operative issue for you isn't what you feel like doing, what you want to do, what every fiber of your being is screaming for you to do, and failing to do it would constitute self-betrayal and self-violation.

No. The operative issue for you is what you're obligated to do.

Obligated by what and for whom? Do you even know? What would you do if you felt no obligation at all? Would you even know what you want? How would you even begin to go about deciding what to do if nothing obligated you one way or another? 

Most people today won't even find those questions intelligible. They won't have a fucking clue what I'm asking.

https://www.thenation.com/article/politics/are-we-the-baddies/
